summary: Comprehensive testing of M365 Command Center (Iteration 170). All 33 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing confirmed all 7 tabs working: Tenants (7 seeded with KPI tiles, universal search, tenant detail with AI Brief and deep links), Users (56 users with Offboard buttons, OffboardingWizard with 7 step checkboxes), Standards (15 standards grouped by 6 categories with toggle switches and Run buttons, results dialog shows Compliant/Drifted/Remediated), GDAP (7 relationships with Role Templates and Extend +1y buttons), Security (MFA Analytics with by-method bars, Secure Score 30-day SVG trend, 8 CA Templates, Anti-AITM CSS Generator), Alerts (5 seeded scripted alerts with New Alert dialog), Connection (4 credential fields with Save/Test buttons, MOCK badge visible).
seed_data_creation: Mock data auto-seeded on first request: 7 tenants, 56 users, 7 GDAP relationships, 15 standards, 8 CA templates, 5 scripted alerts. All tagged with source='m365cc' to avoid collision with legacy CIPP integration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M365 Command Center fully functional. Backend endpoints all working: /api/m365/tenants (list, detail, health/summary, ai-brief), /api/m365/users (with filters), /api/m365/search, /api/m365/standards (CRUD, run, runs history), /api/m365/bpa-report, /api/m365/gdap (list, extend, role-templates), /api/m365/offboarding, /api/m365/mfa-analytics, /api/m365/secure-score/trend, /api/m365/ca-templates (list, deploy), /api/m365/scripted-alerts (CRUD), /api/m365/aitm-page (get/put with CSS generation), /api/m365/connection (get/put/test). Frontend: /m365 route loads M365CommandCenter page with 7 tabs. Sidebar has 'M365 Center' under Integrations section. MOCK badge visible until connection credentials are saved.

backend_endpoints.tenants: GET /api/m365/tenants returns 7 seeded tenants with secure_score, mfa_enrolled_pct, users_count, license_sku, secure_score_30d_trend, status
backend_endpoints.health_summary: GET /api/m365/tenants/health/summary returns {tenants:7, users:644, avg_mfa_pct, avg_secure_score, secure_trend, risky_signins_30d, gdap_expiring_30d}
backend_endpoints.ai_brief: GET /api/m365/tenants/{id}/ai-brief returns AI-written executive brief from Claude Sonnet 4.5
backend_endpoints.standards_update: PUT /api/m365/standards/{id} toggles enabled and updates actions
backend_endpoints.bpa_report: GET /api/m365/bpa-report returns matrix of standards × tenants
backend_endpoints.offboarding: POST /api/m365/offboarding runs steps and disables user in db
backend_endpoints.aitm_page: GET/PUT /api/m365/aitm-page - PUT returns generated CSS string

frontend_components.m365_page: data-testid='m365-page' loads with 7 KPI tiles + 7 tabs
frontend_components.tenants_tab: Universal search box + tenants table with 7 rows, click opens detail dialog with AI Brief
frontend_components.users_tab: Filter by tenant + search + no_mfa toggle, 56 users with Offboard buttons
frontend_components.offboarding_wizard: data-testid='offboarding-wizard' with 7 step checkboxes and Run Offboarding button
frontend_components.standards_tab: Grouped by category (identity/exchange/defender/intune/sharepoint/teams), 15 standards with switches + Run buttons
frontend_components.standards_results: Dialog shows Compliant/Drifted/Remediated tiles + per-tenant list
frontend_components.gdap_tab: Role Templates strip (4 templates) + GDAP table with Extend +1y buttons
frontend_components.security_tab: MFA analytics card with by-method bars, Secure Score 30-day SVG trend, CA Template Library (8 templates), Anti-AITM CSS Generator
frontend_components.alerts_tab: 5 seeded scripted alerts with expression/severity, New Alert dialog
frontend_components.connection_tab: 4 credential fields (app_id/tenant_id/secret/refresh_token), Save + Test buttons, Mode badge
